name: mudelitehas
description: Rebuild and inspect a validated animated teddy bear with a genuine point-cloud-to-Blender workflow.

interface.longDescription: Build, inspect and resume a reproducible walking teddy bear recipe. The workflow uses reviewed reference images, a genuine oriented point cloud saved before mesh generation, a neutral T-pose mesh, skinning, a 23-bone rig and a walking loop. Export animated GLB, a lighter LOD and editable BLEND files, validate the GLB by reimporting it, and prepare version-linked feedback locally. This beta includes one validated 10000-quad biped teddy recipe; it is not an arbitrary creature generator. Designed for execution-capable Work/Codex environments with filesystem and command execution. Blender 4.5.3, Python dependencies and runtime downloads are required. Automatic runtime setup is tested on Linux x64. This is a skills-only plugin, not a hosted Blender service. Installing it does not make Blender run inside ordinary chat or on a phone. Feedback is saved locally and is only sent to GitHub when the user submits it. The canonical example is the latest reviewed walking teddy, preserved byte for byte from the 0.1.0 model release.
defaultPrompt: Build the validated 10000-quad walking teddy with Mudelitehas.
Inspect and resume my existing Mudelitehas teddy run.
Prepare a local feedback bundle for my Mudelitehas model.

publication.release_notes: First portable plugin beta. Includes the validated 0.1.0 teddy engine, official plugin metadata, original teddy preview and local feedback workflow. No changes to canonical model files.

et-EE.subtitle: Animeeritud karu Blenderis
et-EE.description: Loo uuesti kontrollitud jalutav mängukaru: lähtepildid, päris punktipilv, T-poosi võrk, luustik, animatsioon ja GLB kontroll. Beetaversioon toetab üht 10 000 nelinurgaga karuretsepti. Vajab failide ja käskude käivitamisega Worki/Codexi keskkonda, Blenderit 4.5.3 ja Pythoni sõltuvusi; automaatne paigaldus on testitud Linux x64 peal. Paigaldamine ei lisa telefonile Blenderit ega loo eraldi pilveteenust. Tagasisidepakett luuakse kohapeal; GitHubi saatmise otsustab kasutaja. Näidisfailid on viimase üle antud jalutava mängukaru täpsed koopiad.
